findings.body: The `await` was dropped: `store.put` still returns a promise, so `saveDraft` resolves before the write lands and a rejected write surfaces as an unhandled rejection rather than reaching the caller.
findings.suggestedFix: Either restore `await store.put(...)`, or keep it non-blocking deliberately with `void store.put(...).catch(reportWriteFailure)`.

findings.body: This counter now reports a save the system cannot guarantee — the put on the previous line is no longer awaited, so `draft.saved` increments even when the write fails.
findings.suggestedFix: Increment after the write settles, inside the promise chain, so the metric only counts writes that actually landed.

hotspots.reason: The storage write is no longer awaited, so the function reports success before the write has landed.
